Selling physical products to the EU? You need TWO compliance kits, not one.

GPSR (product safety) + EPR/PPWR (packaging) — marketplaces enforce both, and fines stack.

GPSR EU Seller Action Kit ($79): https://aekraft.gumroad.com/l/fetmu?utm_source=nostr&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=s3_exec_05&utm_content=eu_bundle
EU Packaging EPR Action Kit ($69): https://aekraft.gumroad.com/l/gfsvu?utm_source=nostr&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=s3_exec_05&utm_content=eu_bundle

Same buyer, same problem, one checkout each.
